title: (Junior) DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor
description: **Junior DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor** **Location:** This is a full-time, permanent and office-based position in Dublin. You must be comfortable working on-site daily. **Salary:** €30,000–€38,000 We are recruiting a DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor to join the workplace health and wellbeing team of a major international organisation in Dublin. This is a permanent, full-time position supporting employees with Display Screen Equipment assessments, workplace ergonomics, reasonable adjustments and wider healthy-working requirements. The role suits someone with hands-on DSE assessment experience in a corporate environment who enjoys working directly with employees to resolve workplace comfort, ergonomic, and accessibility issues. You will work with employees who may require additional support due to musculoskeletal concerns, pregnancy, neurodiversity, disability or other health-related requirements, helping identify appropriate workplace adjustments and practical solutions. **What you’ll be doing:** **You will:** * Conduct individual DSE and Healthy Working Assessments * Carry out assessments for high-risk employees and new and expectant mothers * Support employees requiring workplace enablement or reasonable adjustments * Review workstation setups and identify ergonomic risks or areas for improvement * Recommend appropriate ergonomic equipment, furniture and workplace adjustments * Conduct both face-to-face and video-based assessments * Produce clear, accurate assessment reports and document recommendations * Manage follow-up assessments and individual cases through to resolution * Work with HR, Health & Safety, Office Operations and Technology teams where required * Support employees with more complex health, accessibility or neurodiverse requirements * Assist with the organisation's on-site Accessibility Centre * Deliver employee drop-in sessions and guide healthy working practices * Liaise with specialist external providers where additional support is required * Support employees at Dublin offices and occasionally at other Dublin client locations **What we’re looking for:** Ideally, you will have at least one year of practical experience carrying out DSE or Healthy Working Assessments. **You should have:** * Experience conducting DSE/workstation assessments * A good understanding of workplace ergonomics * Knowledge of ergonomic equipment and furniture * An understanding of workplace Health & Safety requirements * Confidence dealing directly with employees, including individuals with more complex health or accessibility needs * Strong written communication and report-writing skills * Good organisational and case-management skills * Confidence working independently and managing your own appointment schedule * Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Teams and related workplace systems Experience using DSE assessment platforms such as Cardinus would be advantageous. Candidates from Physiotherapy, Occupational Health, Occupational Therapy, Ergonomics or similar backgrounds may also be considered where they can demonstrate relevant workplace assessment experience. **Right to Work:** Applicants must already hold the unrestricted right to work in Ireland. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. **Start Date:** The organisation is looking to appoint as soon as possible, so candidates available at short notice are particularly welcome. If you have experience supporting employees with workplace ergonomics, DSE assessments and healthy-working solutions and would like to join a large international organisation, we would be interested in hearing from you. Contact: Elvis Eckardt

title: 2027 Early Career Electrical Engineer

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. We are looking for Electrical Engineers to join our rapidly growing team! We hire self-motivated people, those who hold a higher bar for themselves than anyone else could hold for them. If you are eager to solve tough problems, then this role might be for you! **About The Team** The Voyager team at Anduril Industries is an engineering and design division with vast experience in developing innovative computing and communications solutions for the network edge. The Voyager Hardware team develop rugged compute as can be seen here. **What You’ll Do** * Assist in design of electronics from concept to functional prototype, including hardware selection * Troubleshoot issues that span the electrical and software boundaries, with solid skills using both lab equipment (Oscilloscopes, DMM, etc.) and software debugging tools. * Test and qualify new parts such as SSDs or RAM * Develop Python test scripts to load test and stress products * Work closely with other electrical, mechanical, software, firmware, and test engineers to deliver fully functional products. * Work in a fast-paced environment supporting new developments, active deployments, and customer operated hardware. * Concurrently manage involvement in multiple projects at various stages **Required Qualifications** * Completion of a bachelors or masters degree in a technical field such as electronic engineering * Must be available to work full time in our Dublin office * Must be available to start full time in July 2027 **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous internship experience within the electrical engineering space * Familiarity with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, current-probes, and automation of tests. * Familiarity with CPUs such as ARM, x86 at a high level * Familiarity with development processes and tools such JIRA, etc. * Familiarity with standard interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, PCIe, USB, etc. * Exceptional organisational and communication skills (both written and oral). * Experience with OrCAD or equivalent electronic design automation tools. **Benefits** The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information, Explore Our Benefits.* **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind * No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. title: 2027 Ireland Electrical Engineering Placement Opportunity
description: To apply for this opportunity simply upload a CV. This is a placement opportunity that will typically start in around March and last for 6-12 months, however, we are flexible and will discuss your preferred dates during the selection process. **To avoid missing out on your preferred role, we recommend applying** **as early as possible, as positions will close once filled.** **Application process** * Upload CV and cover letter, detailing motivations and suitability for the opportunity. * Online strengths-based assessment This opportunity uses a single-stage strengths-based interview as part of the selection process. Start your career with a global, employee-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one. **Job Description** This placement opportunity will sit in our Transmission and Distribution (T&D) team who play a crucial role in transforming and modernising electricity networks to support the global energy transition. During your placement, you could contribute to projects involving substations, overhead lines, underground cables, grid connections and the integration of renewable energy. Supported by experienced engineers, you may assist with technical studies, design development, data analysis, calculations and the preparation of reports and drawings, while gaining an understanding of safety, sustainability, quality and client requirements across the project lifecycle. **What You’ll Experience** * Collaboration & Community: Work alongside diverse teams who are passionate, supportive, and driven by shared purpose. * Real-World Impact: Contribute to meaningful projects that make a difference - for our business, our communities, and the world. * Learning & Growth: Gain hands-on experience, develop your technical and professional skills, and learn how multidisciplinary teams take projects from early feasibility and design through to delivery. You’ll receive guidance and feedback from experienced colleagues as you discover what drives you. * Belonging & Inclusion: Be part of a culture where everyone is respected, heard, and empowered to thrive. **Candidate Specification** At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated students who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in. To be eligible for this opportunity, you will be in your penultimate year at university and studying towards an Electrical Engineering degree In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests - such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects. We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story. We are looking for students with the following strengths: * Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently. * Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues. * Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity. * Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving. **AI Usage** At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application. **Accessibility** We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help. **About Your Development** A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald. **Our social side** Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in. From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community. It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits. **Agile working** At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust. **Equality, diversity, and inclusion** We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute. **We offer some fantastic benefits including:** * Biannual salary reviews: We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period. * Flexible working * Pension matched up to 7% of base salary * Competitive annual leave * An annual professional institution subscription * Life insurance * Income continuance * Enhanced Paternity leave * Annual company performance bonus scheme – Subject to company performance * Cycle to work scheme * Travel TaxSaver tickets * Commitment to Continuing Professional Development – we are accredited by Engineers Ireland * A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self-development options. **Networks, communities, and social outcomes** * Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities. * Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes. Location(s): Dublin, IE Contract Type: Contract Work Pattern: Full Time Market: Energy Discipline: Electrical Job Ref: 17563 Recruiter Contact: earlycareers.recruitment@mottmac.com

title: 2027 Summer Intern - Trade Support Analyst, EMEA
description: PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns. Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients. **2027 Summer Internship – Trade Support Analyst, Dublin** **Internship positions are located in Dublin, Ireland** **You’re Eligible To Apply If You** * Are an undergraduate currently pursuing a degree with an expected graduation date of December 2027 – June 2028 * Have a minimum, predicted, 2:1 from an accredited university * Are business proficient in English **You’ll excel as a Trade Support Analyst if you:** * Demonstrate advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Excel-based calculations, presenting data in the accurate format, simple macro builds, using Excel functions to analyze data). * Have demonstrated curiosity and experience in using new emerging technologies and AI tools in your work or school projects to solve problems and drive better outcomes * Have proficiency in at least one of the following: Python, SQL, and/or VBA. * Show a strong interest in the financial markets, macroeconomics, and investment finance. * Possess outstanding analytical skills with the ability to function efficiently and problem-solve in a fast paced and time-critical environment. * Show outstanding communication skills which enable you to operate in a complex financial and mathematical environment. * Show the following traits: ethical, collaborative, organized, flexible, high energy, self-starter, accountable, humble. * Have undertaken finance, fixed income, and/or capital markets coursework (recommended but not required). **Responsibilities Of The Role Include** * Ensuring investment objectives are reflected across portfolios in scope. * Monitoring portfolio positions and products versus client guidelines in concert with Compliance team. * Coordinating with Portfolio Management on re-balancing of portfolios. * Utilizing proprietary risk systems for monitoring portfolio exposures. * Assisting in account transitions and cash flow management. * Conducting performance and attribution analyses. * Responding to ad hoc requests from the Portfolio Management team. **See Yourself As a Trade Support Analyst** You’ll serve in a dynamic role alongside Associates on the team, providing key support across Portfolio Management and Trading desks. Trade Support Analysts directly support Associates, Traders, and Portfolio Managers. They build relationships internally with Account Managers, Product Managers, Legal and Compliance counterparts, Operations teams, and other Portfolio Associate teams across the firm’s global offices. On a day-to-day basis, Trade Support Analyst use their mathematical and fixed income training to actively monitor portfolios to assist Portfolio Managers in managing risk and client assets. Trade Support Analysts are routinely encouraged to provide creative solutions and develop key tools and reporting methods to support the Portfolio Management team. You’ll develop meaningful partnerships through cross-department training and a collaborative team project. Throughout the course of the summer, you’ll be encouraged to showcase an understanding of advanced fixed income concepts and general portfolio management concepts, while operating in an inspiring environment. **The PIMCO Internship Experience** * The PIMCO Internship is a 10-week program that runs from early June to mid-August, with the expectation that you will be available for the full duration of the program * During Week 1, you’ll participate in PIMCO Fundamentals Training, providing you with the skills, knowledge, and relationships that will prepare you for success * Alongside your colleagues, participate in PIMCO's Global Month of Volunteering, developed to heighten the impact of our employees' worldwide volunteer efforts * Join us for a variety of cross-divisional education, networking & social events! * Your supervisor, peer mentor, senior leaders and team offer guidance and mentorship throughout the summer * You will gain hands-on experience with AI-powered tools from day one, with training and resources that help build future ready skills and make an impact from the start * You’ll receive feedback at mid- and end-of-summer as part of a formal review process to keep you on the path to meeting your summer goals * Want to learn more? Hear about The PIMCO Internship Experience from past interns * As a PIMCO intern, you’ll receive competitive compensation, along with a transition bonus to help with relocation to one of our office locations **How You Should Apply** We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply by submitting your resume as soon as you are ready. **What To Expect During The Interview Process** * After we receive your application, we will conduct an initial review of your resume * If you are selected to move forward, you will be invited to complete a one-way video interview and assessment, giving you the opportunity to showcase your interests, skills, and personality as part of the next stage of the process. * Once you complete the assessment, you will have a final round of live interviews with us conducted live via video conference. Interviews typically consist of behavioral and technical concepts, as well as an Excel assessment. Applications for the internship program are reviewed in phases. success, account management, sales, or another customer-facing role, ideally in SaaS or tech. * Demonstrated ability to think critically, solve problems in ambiguous situations, and guide customers with limited information. * Analytical and data-driven mindset with experience using metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. * Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally, with the capacity to adjust your style across different audiences. * Demonstrated organizational habits, attention to detail, and a consistent approach to documentation and data hygiene. * Track record of meeting or exceeding customer impact metrics with a results-oriented approach. **Posting Date** Posting Date: October 24, 2026 Application Window: October 24 - November 10, 2026 We title: Cybersecurity Graduate Consultant
description: Graduate - Cybersecurity See it differently You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future. Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities. The Opportunity The Cybersecurity team embodies Arup’s Total Design philosophy by integrating people, processes, technology and physical assets into cohesive cybersecurity strategies that are embedded from concept through to implementation. The team works with a variety of public sector organisations, including Transport Infrastructure Ireland. With reference to our Cybersecurity service within Digital Services, it exemplifies Arup’s Total Design by embedding cybersecurity and resilience governance frameworks, proactive cybersecurity risk intelligence and compliance assurance into the design, implementation and operational phase of projects—ensuring that systems, processes and people are holistically protected from cybersecurity threats. Arup is at the forefront of smart and connected building, city and transport technology and our cyber-advisory specialists have expertise in Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Automation Control Systems (IACS) and IoT technology. We advise clients on risk and vulnerability analysis and propose mitigation strategies that enhance infrastructure resilience and safety. This is an office-based role, with successful candidates expected to work 5 days per week in the Arup office in Cork or Dublin **The Candidate Will Be Expected To** * Deliver high-quality cyber advisory services to Arup projects and clients * Support cybersecurity risk, gap and assurance assessments across digital, cloud, system, application, AI, Data * Contribute to Operational Technology /Industrial Automation Control System security requirements, architectures and governance outputs * Engage with stakeholders to understand risks and provide clear recommendations * Support supplier assurance, documentation reviews and audit readiness * Produce structured deliverables (risk registers, requirements, reports, roadmaps, specifications) * Support proposals, scope development and delivery planning * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to embed cybersecurity into project outcomes Is this role right for you? Arup is looking for a technically capable cybersecurity Graduate with experience in cybersecurity risk-based advisory and assurance, who communicates clearly and enjoys working in multidisciplinary teams supporting the built environment and connected infrastructure For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes: **A Minimum Undergraduate / Bachelor's Level (or Equivalent) In** * Computer Science (incl. Cybersecurity); Data Science / Engineering * Risk Management; Threat & Vulnerability Management; Security Design; Network Security; Infrastructure Security; Application Security; Data Security; Cloud Security (AWS; Azure; Google Cloud); * Network Design; Application Design; Cybersecurity Management; NIST CSF; ISA/IEC 62443; ISO 19650; CompTIA Security+; CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst+, CompTIA Network+; * Problem Solving; Technical Excellence; Communication (written and verbal) https://www.arup.com/en-us/services/technology-and-cybersecurity-consulting/ https://www.arup.com/services/resilience-security-and-risk/ * To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria: * Full working rights in the country of application * No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role * Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts. Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes; * Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key. * Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo. * Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working. * Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way. **Closing date:** 12 November 2026 Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended. **Eligibility** We're able to consider candidates who require an employment permit to work in Ireland, where the role and offered salary meet the Irish Government's eligibility criteria (for example, under the Critical Skills or General Employment Permit schemes). All Employment Permits are granted at the discretion of the Deciding Officer with offers contingent to obtaining the correct immigration to work and reside in Ireland. What we offer you At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts. We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates. Different people, shared values Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. Candidates may inform us of any disability, learning difference, or other circumstance that may require reasonable adjustments for interviews or assessments. Any information provided will be used only to make appropriate arrangements and will not be considered in any other aspect of your application or selection process. #IRELAND\_GRADS

title: Dublin Summer Internship
description: Careers grow faster when purpose is clear On our internship, you’ll see the impact we make in Ireland and around the world while exploring the intersection of law, business and technology. You’ll start building the foundations of a global legal career, working collaboratively with colleagues and clients on high‑value matters that shape industries. During the 2-3 week, in-person, paid internship, you could be attending court hearings, working directly with clients, collaborating with leading professionals, and you’ll get hands‑on experience of life at a global law firm. This internship goes beyond shadowing. You’ll be part of the team, trusted to take ownership and contribute meaningfully. Discover how DLA Piper combines legal know how, business insight and innovation to deliver exceptional client outcomes. You’ll develop the skills, behaviours and mindset needed to thrive as a commercial lawyer, while building relationships with partners, lawyers and trainees who will guide your growth and development. **Application for our 2027 Dublin Summer Internship will open on Monday 21st September.** Once you have completed your internship, you could be offered a place in our Future Lawyers Pathway. What you will do * Start your journey with an interactive induction in London, connecting with fellow interns from across the programme and building your network from day one. * Immerse yourself in complex work, gaining insight into how our practice and sector groups around the world help clients navigate change. * Join a collaborative, forward-looking team, contribute to real client matters, and experience the pace and variety of work at DLA Piper. * Accelerate your development through structured learning opportunities that will strengthen your professional skills. * Benefit from a network of supervisors, buddies and mentors who will encourage and challenge you and help you make the most of your experience. * Broaden your perspective by exploring areas such as legal technology, sustainability and responsible business,, highlighting the various ways you can make an impact at DLA Piper. **You Can Apply If You Are** In your penultimate year of your degree **or** In the final year of your degree **or** A graduate/ changing careers **Academic Requirements** We welcome applications from candidates studying any degree subject. You should have achieved, or be on track to achieve, a 2:1 undergraduate degree (or equivalent) and have achieved a minimum of 450 CAO points in the Irish Leaving Certificate (or an equivalent qualification). We recognise that everyone's circumstances are different and will consider mitigating circumstances on a case-by-case basis. **Right To Work In Ireland** You must have the right to work in Dublin on a full-time basis (40 hours per week) for the entire duration of the Summer Internship. If you hold a Student visa, you must be able to demonstrate that you are permitted to work full-time from the internship start date (typically the third week of June), based on your university's official term and vacation dates. Unfortunately, DLA Piper is unable to provide visa sponsorship for the Summer Internship programme. However, if you are successful in securing a place on our Future Lawyers Pathway and subsequently receive an offer to join us as a trainee solicitor, DLA Piper is able to provide visa sponsorship. Key information **Applications open** for our 2027 Summer Internship on the 21st September 2026 **Applications close** for our 2027 Summer Internship on the 15th January 2027 at 17:00 Before starting your application, you'll be taken to our anonymous Realistic Job Preview to explore the role, learn about our ways of working and receive personalised feedback. **Programme Dates:** Normally Mid June 2027 - Mid July 2027 Applicants will be assessed for a place on the Future Lawyers Pathway, commencing in Autumn 2029. Our Early Careers team reviews all applications and assessment results, and human judgement remains an important part of deciding who advances to the next stage throughout the process. We are committed to a fair, transparent and inclusive recruitment process. Under applicable data protection laws, you may have rights relating to automated processing and profiling, including the right to request further information or a review of relevant decisions. For more information, please see our privacy notice here.

title: Enterprise Success Executive
description: SIRO was launched in 2015 as a joint venture between Vodafone and ESB. Our key mission is to build a nationwide 100% fibre broadband network – we commit to changing Ireland’s telecom landscape and delivering the fastest most innovative broadband experience to the Irish consumer. We are an award-winning employer with a very friendly and supportive corporate culture. The business offices are located at Carrickmines, Dublin and we offer a flexible hybrid work environment. Enterprise is an important channel within SIRO’s Commercial Team. We work with retail and operator partners to bring SIRO Enterprise fibre products to business customers. We are looking for a curious, organised and highly motivated graduate to join the Enterprise team. This is a developmental role offering practical experience across enterprise operations, partner support, reporting, data analysis, service delivery, CRM, bids and commercial projects. You will work alongside experienced colleagues and receive guidance as you build your commercial, analytical and relationship-management capability. **Role Purpose** To support the Enterprise team in delivering a responsive and reliable service to SIRO’s partners. The role will coordinate information, maintain accurate systems and reports, track actions and orders, and help colleagues resolve partner queries. Over time, the graduate will build a strong understanding of SIRO’s enterprise products, processes and commercial operations and take on greater responsibility as capability develops. **Key Responsibilities:** **Partner and service support** * Support the Enterprise team with day-to-day partner presale and price queries. * Tracking and creating bids and quotations for partners. * Managing the commercial approval process for enterprise orders, involving appropriate stakeholders. * Prepare clear updates for colleagues and partners, escalating issues to the appropriate team member when required. * Build positive working relationships with internal teams and external partners through dependable follow-up and clear communication. **Reporting and data** * Prepare daily, weekly and monthly performance reports using available business systems and source files. * Check data for accuracy, investigate differences and highlight relevant trends or issues to the team. * Support teams on creation of reports to support business processes. * Present findings clearly using Excel, PowerPoint and short written summaries. **CRM, systems and administration** * Maintain accurate CRM records, including premises, eligibility, serviceability and order updates. * Raise and monitor tickets relating to new premises, eligibility changes and other commercial queries. * Maintain organised records, action logs and supporting documentation; and maintain ourEnterprise team document store. **Commercial and project support** * Assist with bid documentation, commercial quotes and the preparation of information for business cases. * Coordinate order-related inputs from teams such as Finance, Build, Plan and Design, GIS, Operations, Legal, and Enterprise Delivery. * Contribute analysis and administration to commercial footprint expansion and other Enterprise projects. * Being proactive with suggestions on practical improvements to reports, processes, systems and ways of working. **Requirements:** * A recent graduate, or someone at an early stage of their career, with a relevant qualification in business, commerce, analytics, economics, marketing, technology, project management or a related discipline. * Strong organisation skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage actions and deadlines are the most important attributes for this role. * Confidence working with numbers and an interest in developing data-analysis skills. * Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain and present information clearly both internally and externally. * A customer-focused and collaborative approach. * Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to learn about telecoms, enterprise customers and SIRO’s commercial operations. * Comfortable with instructions, working independently and also part of a team. * Comfort using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with support available to develop more advanced capability. Excel skills in particular are important to this role and a short task will be given during the interview. * Ability to work independently on agreed tasks while knowing when to ask for guidance or escalate an issue. * Must attend the SIRO office a minimum of 2 days per week as per our hybrid working policy. **Preferred:** * Work placement, internship, part-time or project experience in an office, customer service, commercial or analytical environment. * An interest in telecommunications, digital infrastructure or B2B services. * Exposure to CRM, ticketing, reporting or data-visualisation tools. * Experience preparing presentations, reports or analysis as part of a college or workplace project. **SIRO & Equality** SIRO believes in equality for all. We strive to create a workplace that is diverse and mirrors the customers, community, and colleagues that we serve. We encourage, support, and celebrate our differences and foster an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their full authentic selves to work. We offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, colleague engagement forums, and services to support staff from different backgrounds. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us.

title: Field Service Technician - Talent Pool (Dublin)
description: **About Miele** How does a family-owned company become the global market leader in the premium segment for domestic appliances and a trusted partner for solutions in commercial and medical technology? By striving to always do better and to keep improving. This mindset defines what it means to work at Miele and drives the success of our products. Our approximately 23,000 employees can rely on one thing: those who embrace our commitment to quality will grow – both personally and professionally.**​** **Talent Pool: Domestic Premium Appliance Field Engineer (Dublin)** **Please note, this is a Talent Pool and not a live vacancy. You are registering your interest in Field Service Technician opportunities in the Dublin area.** *Opportunities will be full-time (40 hours per week) with the option to work this across 4 or 5 days a week.* The Miele Service team is an award-winning service delivery function, supporting the needs of our domestic customers directly in their homes. We hire the best technicians from the white goods sector to join our field service community. Our team is built on a legacy of excellence and innovation that dates back to 1899. We are proud to offer a workplace and culture that is as future proof as our world-renowned products. At Miele, we don’t just build appliances—we build careers. Join us in living our philosophy of being ‘Immer Besser’—Forever Better. **About the role** Working independently, we give you the tools to succeed. title: Financial Analyst Intern 2027
description: **Description** There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon. At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. title: Front Desk Associate
description: **About Us** At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work. **About The Opportunity** As a Front Desk Associate, you’ll be the heart and “face” of WeWork’s hospitality team as the primary point of contact for our members and guests! While no one day will look exactly the same, you will report to one of WeWork’s beautiful locations on weekdays only to support the Community Management team. Depending on the location you are assigned, you’ll either work with a variety of members from different backgrounds and industries, or focus your efforts on one of our Enterprise clients. Employees supporting our Enterprise locations may have different holidays, technical systems, operational and relationship requirements, and property management responsibilities than employees in our Classic locations. **Duties** **Your work, which will include but not be limited to the duties listed below, will help WeWork to achieve the following:** * Create a welcoming community environment for our members and guests (and sometimes their pets!) by greeting all who enter our spaces warmly. * Make members and guests feel known and cared for by proactively learning their names, answering their questions, and addressing their needs or concerns. * Support the Community Management team with maintaining the front desk operations throughout the day including mail and package handling. * Help ensure your building is fully operational and make adjustments when needed. * Take direction from the Community Associate, Community Lead and the Community Manager to support the Community Team as necessary. * Be an expert in WeWork products and services and appropriately promote WeWork-provided service offerings to our members and guests. * All of this while illustrating WeWork’s core values and working towards achieving our mission. **In this role, you’ll be responsible for the following areas:** **Front Desk Management** * Greet all members and guests with a warm and welcoming demeanor. * Cover the front desk during the building’s set business hours and be an on-site point of contact for members, located at the Community Bar. * Ensure visiting guests are registered and checked in and in accordance with WeWork’s guest policies. * Provide orientation of our spaces and relevant information to ensure all first-time visitors and guests feel welcome and supported. * Support with issuing and collect keys from members and guests as needed. * Keep the front desk clean, organized and free of clutter at all times. * Notify members of any food deliveries and packages. **Member Engagement** * Learn the names of members and guests and get to know their businesses with the goal of building relationships in order to facilitate the sense of Community that WeWork is known for. * Keep track of relevant member notes and information in WeWork systems. * Answer questions from members and guests knowledgeably and be able to offer appropriate WeWork products and solutions to support where relevant. * Identify opportunities to celebrate members’ successes and milestones. * Know and be able to explain WeWork policies and procedures to members and guests. * Know and recommend local restaurants, food delivery services, catering options, team outing venues, post office, shipping center, supply store, etc. **Building Operations and Management** * Assist with the handling mail and packages throughout the day including receiving, processing, sorting and organizing. * Know and be able to explain WeWork policies and procedures around mail and mailroom. * Monitor our spaces and make adjustments when needed, for example, picking up rubbish, resetting chairs, and straightening pillows. * Help maintain building amenities throughout the day, for example, restocking of the Community treat bowl, keycards, printers, etc. * Respond to emergencies and incidents promptly and appropriately, escalating and recording as needed. **About You** We’d love to hear from you if you meet the qualifications below: * You’re a people-person—you enjoy meeting new people from all walks of life * In-person interactions energize you and you have outstanding interpersonal skills * You feel comfortable and confident being the face of the brand * Helping others gives you a sense of accomplishment * You work well in a team and can roll up your sleeves to help when needed * You’re able to multitask while always prioritizing the member experience * You’ve worked in hospitality / retail or customer service before which is preferred but not required * You have strong verbal and written communication skills * You are comfortable with and proficient in basic computer skills * You demonstrate and value integrity, dependability, responsibility, accountability, self-awareness, work ethic, and compassion * You show a passion and understanding of WeWork’s mission and values * You have a secondary school certificate which is preferred but not required **Life at WeWork** Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.

title: Global Tours Sales Representative | Salary + Uncapped Commission
description: **Your Passport to a Sales Career (Pun Intended)** Ever planned a friend's entire trip just because you couldn't help yourself? Finished a Tourism degree and thought "cool, now what?" Been told you "talk too much" by someone who clearly doesn't get your gift? You might be exactly who we're looking for. We're the team behind four of the most loved travel brands around: **Go Irish Tours, Go Asian Tours, Go New Zealand Tours,** and **Go Italia Trips**, helping travelers cross destinations off their bucket lists across Ireland, Asia, New Zealand, and Italy. One of our brands alone has 700+ reviews and a 4.8 out of 5 rating, and that didn't happen by accident. We're growing, and we're hiring a General Travel and Tours Agent. During the process, you'll be matched with the destination that best fits your interests, strengths, and personality, so you'll be focused on becoming an expert in one region, not stretched across all four. Think less "jack of all destinations" and more "the person everyone calls when they want to go to Ireland, Asia, New Zealand, or Italy done right." This isn't a "sit at a desk and read a script" kind of job. It's part matchmaker, part storyteller, part closer, all fun (with real targets, because we're not running a charity here, we're running a business that just happens to be a joy to work in). **Who We're Looking For** Forget the "must have 5+ years experience" nonsense. Competitive base pay plus uncapped commission, so your hustle actually shows up in your bank account * Career growth that's actually real. We're expanding across multiple destinations right now, which means leadership roles are opening up, and we'd genuinely love to promote from within. * We're hiring 100 people across our brands right now, which means genuine, fast-tracked opportunity for anyone ready to go all in. Hence, the reason why we post every week. * A workplace that takes the work seriously and itself not so much. Targets are real. Yes, actual travel, to places like Dubai, Cape Town, and Asia * A rare moment to get in early on something growing fast, with brands people already love and trust **Sound Like You?** If you've got the gift of the gab, a genuine love of travel, and a hunger to build something more than just a job, we want to hear from you. Tourism grads, career changers, natural talkers, competitive spirits, this one's for you. Apply today and our team will contact you within 24-48 hours. title: Graduate BIM Engineer
description: **Overview** **Graduate BIM Engineer** John Sisk & Son are looking for proactive, talented 4D/BIM Graduates in the business in Ireland across the different regions to join our 2027 Early Careers Graduate Programme. **The role** Our structured 27-month graduate programme is designed to give you hands-on experience across a wide range of construction projects, helping you build the career you want. If you’ve recently graduated or are about to graduate, with a degree in 4D/BIM Engineering , and you're ready to take charge of your future with a leading building contractor, we could be the perfect fit. This is your opportunity to make an impact and grow with us. **Who We Are** Established in 1859, Sisk is proud to be in its fifth generation of family ownership. Our founding values of care, excellence, and integrity continue to shape everything we do. With a clear vision of Building Excellence, we consistently deliver high-quality projects that exceed client expectations. Our people are the driving force behind our success, and we’re now looking for the next generation of graduates to help us carry that legacy forward. **A journey to your future** Our Graduate Programme is a carefully designed 27-month rotational journey that offers up to **three business rotations across the UK, Ireland, and Europe** , giving you broad exposure and the opportunity to shape your career path, fusing technical excellence, commercial acumen, and leadership capabilities. From day one, you'll follow a detailed development plan aligned to a clear timeline, ensuring you gain the experience and competencies required to pursue professional chartership. We’re committed to helping you build a strong technical foundation and excel in your chosen area of specialism. The programme blends structured learning, hands-on project work, and expert mentoring to deliver both depth and breadth of knowledge. With robust progress tracking, regular feedback, and a dedicated support network, you’ll be empowered to grow with confidence and make a meaningful impact. **What We Are Looking For** * A collaborative team player with fresh ideas, ready to challenge yourself, and us, every step of the way. title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
description: **Description** Designer Group is seeking **Graduate Electrical Engineers** to join our growing teams, with **multiple positions available for immediate start** . This is an excellent opportunity for recent Electrical Engineering graduates who want to build a career with a leading international mechanical and electrical contractor. You will gain hands-on experience across live projects, working alongside experienced engineers, project teams, commercial teams and site leadership. As a Graduate Electrical Engineer, you will support the delivery of electrical building services across a range of projects, which may include commercial, industrial, pharmaceutical, data centre, residential, energy and infrastructure environments. You will be exposed to both office-based and site-based work, giving you a strong practical understanding of how electrical systems are designed, coordinated, installed, tested and commissioned. Designer Group’s graduate programme is designed to support early-career professionals through practical project experience, mentoring, structured development and exposure to major engineering projects across Ireland, the UK and Europe. The existing graduate programme is positioned as a two-year programme providing hands-on experience across core teams and project environments. **Key Responsibilities Will Include** * Supporting project teams with the delivery of electrical services from early-stage planning through to installation, testing and commissioning. * Assisting with technical reviews, drawings, specifications, submittals and project documentation. * Working with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors and site teams to support safe and efficient project delivery. * Supporting quality, safety and compliance requirements across electrical works. * Assisting with progress tracking, reporting, materials coordination and issue resolution. * Developing practical knowledge of M&E contracting, construction sequencing, programme requirements and client expectations. * Building your technical understanding of electrical systems, site coordination, project delivery and engineering best practice. * Participating in training, mentoring and continuous professional development as part of your graduate journey. **Requirements** **Minimum requirements:** * Level 7 or Level 8 qualification in Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline. * Strong interest in electrical building services, M&E contracting and construction project delivery. * Good communication, organisation and problem-solving skills. * Ability to work well as part of a team and take direction from experienced engineers and project leaders. * Proactive attitude, strong work ethic and willingness to learn. * Comfortable working in both office and site-based environments. * Available to start immediately or at short notice. **Preferred But Not Essential** * Previous placement, internship or site experience within construction, M&E, building services, utilities, energy, pharma, commercial or data centre environments. * Basic understanding of electrical drawings, schematics, technical specifications or construction documentation. * Exposure to AutoCAD, Revit, BIM, Microsoft Project, Excel or other engineering/project tools. * Interest in progressing toward professional development, CPD and chartership. **Benefits** At Designer Group, our people are central to our continued growth. We invest in graduates through structured development, mentoring and exposure to real project delivery from the beginning of their careers. **Benefits Include** * Full-time permanent employment. * Structured graduate development. * Mentoring from experienced engineering professionals. * Exposure to major M&E projects. * Pathway to chartership. * CPD training, including Engineers Ireland-accredited development. * International project opportunities. * Competitive salary. * Pension plan. * Health plan. * Life cover. * Travel and subsistence allowances where applicable. * Bike to Work scheme. * Social committee and employee events. * Third-level education grant support. Designer Group is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

title: Internal IT Specialist
description: **Who We Are** Learnosity was born from a desire for change. Back in 2007 our founders Gav and Mark saw that educational technology was treated as an afterthought and left trailing far behind the rapid digital advances in other industries. They believed that because learners owned the future, they deserved not just better technology, but the best. The drive to make a real difference has taken Learnosity a long way. Having started as a two-man team working from a garden shed in the Irish town of Drogheda, Learnosity has gone on to become one of the world's top edtech companies, as named by TIME Magazine. Today Learnosity is the global leader in assessment solutions, but our people are still driven by the same mission. AI is the next great frontier for assessment, and Learnosity is looking for the brightest minds to help us create a brighter future. **The Role** We are searching for an Internal IT Specialist to join our small team. This is a part-time role (20 hours a week, mornings, five days in our Dublin office) where you'll be primarily focused on supporting our Dublin office, while also helping cover the gap between our Australian IT support going offline and our US-based IT support coming online, supporting the wider business globally across time zones. You will be the sole IT resource on the ground in our Dublin office. The Internal IT Specialist reports to the IT Manager, based in the US, and works closely with employees across Learnosity, providing hands-on, day-to-day IT support and helping to keep our people set up and productive. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their IT career to grow your skills across a global, dual-stack IT environment, while learning from and supporting the wider IT team. **Requirements** **Core Goals and Responsibilities:** The role is focused on hands-on, front-line IT support and is best suited to someone who is customer-focused, eager to learn, and comfortable working independently in a small team. As such, you will: * Provide day-to-day IT support to employees on hardware, software and account issues, in person and remotely * Log, triage and resolve support tickets via Zendesk * Own user onboarding and offboarding, including account setup and deactivation * Purchase, set up and configure end-user hardware and peripherals * Manage Google Workspace and Microsoft 365/Azure Active Directory account administration * Maintain accurate, up-to-date IT asset registries * Provide timely updates to users on the status of system issues or outages * Create and maintain documentation of IT systems and procedures * Escalate more complex issues to the IT Manager as needed, with enough context to resolve quickly **Experience and Skills** **Must haves:** * A qualification in systems administration or Prior experience in an IT helpdesk, office support, or customer service role * Can independently image, enroll, and troubleshoot Mac devices via Jamf. macOS is our primary platform * Can competently troubleshoot and support Windows devices enrolled via Microsoft Intune/Azure AD * Can administer Google Workspace accounts end-to-end: user provisioning and deprovisioning, group and sharing-permissions management. * Can administer Microsoft 365/Azure Active Directory accounts end-to-end: user provisioning, group and permissions management, device enrollment * Can troubleshoot and maintain basic networking setups: Wi-Fi connectivity, site-to-site and client VPNs, and IP/DNS conflicts * Strong communicator, able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical colleagues * Proactive rather than reactive — happy to spot and flag issues before they become problems * Good attention to detail and problem-solving skills * Comfortable working independently, and confident asking for help or escalating when needed **It would be great if you had:** * Exposure to tools such as Slack, Confluence, or Zendesk * Experience or interest in scripting with Google APIs (e.g. Apps Script) * An interest in using AI tools to help drive process innovation and automation * An interest in building a career in IT systems administration **Benefits** **Values** We are a values-based company, and our 4 core values are the basis for how we work and what we do every day. Being a part of the Learnosity team means that you'll get to join us in living out these values: * We live to learn * We aim higher * We do the right thing * Our success is better shared **Benefits** Being part of the Learnosity team is a commitment to push yourself and those around you to do better, constantly adapt and learn new techniques, and be able to apply yourself to any challenge, whether you're just starting out or a veteran of the industry. We are keen to try and maximize the value of your time and will design a schedule around your preferred working style, whether you need to accommodate a school or daycare run, avoid busy commute periods, have a gym or sports club schedule, we'll do our best to accommodate you. Our benefits package includes: * Your own Annual Learning Budget * Flexible work practices * Generous paid parental leave * Team social budgets * Career support * Private Medical Insurance * Pension **DIVERSITY & INCLUSION** At Learnosity, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered. We believe that diversity of thought, background, and experience drives innovation and enriches our community. As a tech company in the education space, we are dedicated to creating educational solutions that reflect the diverse needs of our global audience. Find out more about your career at Learnosity at https://learnosity.com/company/careers/ Please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy Salary & package dependent on experience. **Please only contact us if you are a candidate interested in applying for this role. You must have the right to live and work in Ireland to apply - No Recruiters Please.**

title: Investigator Payments Coordinator

You will execute operational response to real-time network events and anomalies – mitigating their impact before significant service degradation occurs. You will facilitate incident response, engaging and supporting engineering teams to triage and resolve major issues. You will work with engineers across disciplines and external partners to ensure that all problems are root-caused and mitigated to prevent future recurrence. You will manage changes and maintenance required to improve and sustain service for users, while ensuring minimal network downtime. As an embedded operator within the NOC you will work with operations engineering to improve operational processes, increase operational efficiency, and maximize operational capabilities. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Detect and triage emerging anomalies on satellites, ground stations, terrestrial network interop, terrestrial network interconnections, network co-location sites, and internet points of presence * Provide centralized awareness and management of routine and emergency maintenance performed by SpaceX personnel and partner contractors * Execute rapid incident response for major network disruptions * Own investigation, troubleshooting and resolution efforts for common network issues * Provide advanced troubleshooting support and resolution for complex residential and enterprise escalations in coordination with internal teams * Measure, preserve, and improve the uptime and performance of the Starlink Network * Follow and improve processes used for operating the Starlink Network **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * High school diploma or equivalency certificate * 1+ year of professional experience troubleshooting and operating computer systems in a network, IT, or security setting including but not limited to a Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), Data Center Operations etc. **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Ability to take on projects that require taking initiative and developing new expertise * Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment that includes working with fast changing needs and requirements * Experience in mission-critical operations where outstanding attention to detail and communication is required to ensure success * Industry recognized technical certifications (i.e. Network+, Security+, CCNA, JNCIA, etc) * Ability to perform network troubleshooting using packet captures and/or device telemetry to root cause network issues * Familiarity with modern networking technologies including but not limited to: * Connectivity (MAC, WiFi, WDM, IPv4 and IPv6) * Switching (STP, VLANs, VXLANs, QinQ) * Routing (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RDMA) * Network services (DNS, DHCP, NTP, NAT) * Network security Science, Cybersecurity or STEM discipline **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Must be available for day time on-shift rotations and weekends as needed **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $55,000 - 110,000 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: location, job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. title: Newly Qualified Solicitor

ALG is also ranked as a 'top tier' law firm in The Legal 500 EMEA Guide 2026 and the IFLR1000 Guide 2026. The firm is consistently ranked number one in the Irish market and on a European level. title: Part Qualifed Accountant

title: Portfolio Analyst/Associate
description: PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns. Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients. **Position Description** PIMCO is seeking an analytically minded, technology-curious professional to join its Dublin team as a Portfolio Analyst / Associate. Supporting portfolio management across PIMCO’s European trading rooms, the role combines investment analysis, trading desk support, portfolio maintenance and risk monitoring across a broad range of mandates and products. The successful candidate will work closely with Portfolio Managers and partner teams across Account Management, Product Management, Legal and Compliance, and the cash desks to monitor portfolio positioning against investment guidelines, benchmarks and model weights. Strong fixed income knowledge, analytical rigor and technical skills will be key, with responsibility for portfolio studies, performance and positioning analysis, and delivering timely insights to support investment decisions. The role also offers scope to improve how the team works, using automation, data analytics and AI-enabled tools to enhance portfolio management processes and workflows. With close exposure to experienced Portfolio Managers and PIMCO’s broader European investment platform, this is a strong opportunity for someone looking to deepen their investment expertise while helping shape more efficient, technology-enabled ways of working. **Key Responsibilities** Portfolio Management & Trading Support * Partner with European portfolio management teams to support trading desk activities and day-to-day portfolio maintenance. * Rebalance portfolios to model and target weights, coordinating with the trading and cash desks as required. * Monitor client portfolio position weights and product positioning against client guidelines and benchmarks. * Review and ensure pre- and post-trade compliance, working with Legal and Compliance to resolve potential issues promptly. Portfolio Analytics & Reporting * Generate studies across a set of mandates or products in accordance with investment guidelines and benchmarks. * Prepare portfolio summaries and monitor portfolio performance. * Conduct performance and attribution analysis, along with other analytics requested by Portfolio Managers. * Create and maintain reports for risk monitoring, highlighting key exposures and changes for Portfolio Managers. Stakeholder Partnership * Build strong working relationships with Portfolio Management, Account Management, Product Management, Legal and Compliance, and the cash desks. * Communicate analysis, ideas and strategies clearly and concisely to Portfolio Managers, both verbally and in writing. * Work collaboratively across the organization to identify and resolve issues. Process Improvement & Innovation * Lead and contribute to project work focused on improving portfolio management processes and workflows. * Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, accuracy and controls through automation, data analytics (e.g., Python, SQL, VBA) and emerging technologies, including AI tools. **Essential** **Position Requirements** * Degree in finance, economics, mathematics or another quantitative/analytical field from a leading university, or equivalent experience. * Strong technical knowledge of fixed income markets and instruments. * Advanced Excel and Bloomberg skills. * Proficiency in at least one of the following: Python, SQL or VBA. * Demonstrated curiosity about, and experience using, new and emerging technologies and AI tools in your work. * Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail. * Ability to interact, communicate and build relationships with experienced Portfolio Managers, articulating ideas and strategies clearly, both verbally and in writing. * Ability to work collaboratively across the organization to resolve issues. * Proven track record of working efficiently in high-pressure environments and consistently meeting tight deadlines. **Preferred** * Experience in portfolio management support, portfolio analytics, trading support or a related investment role within asset management. * Exposure to performance attribution, risk analytics or investment guideline/pre- and post-trade compliance processes. * Progress toward the CFA or a similar professional qualification. title: Quality Analyst / Quality Improvement Analyst
description: At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. As a Quality Analyst / Quality Improvement Analyst, you'll play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of major rail and highways infrastructure programmes across Ireland. Working alongside experienced quality and project teams, you'll help improve processes, strengthen governance, identify opportunities for innovation and support continuous improvement initiatives that drive business performance. Working closely with operational teams and business leaders, you'll help identify efficiencies, improve ways of working and support quality assurance activities that enhance project delivery. What You'll Be Doing * Supporting quality assurance and continuous improvement programmes across the business. * Assisting with process mapping, workflow analysis and business improvement initiatives. * Analysing data to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. * Producing reports, dashboards and quality performance metrics. * Supporting internal audits, compliance reviews and governance activities. * Assisting with root cause analysis and corrective action planning. * Identifying opportunities to leverage automation, AI and digital tools to improve efficiency. * Supporting the implementation of process improvements and change initiatives. * Maintaining quality management systems, processes and documentation. You'll likely have * A degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Business, Data Analytics, Project Management or a related discipline. * Experience within quality, business improvement, engineering, project support or a related field. * An understanding of quality management and continuous improvement principles. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Experience using Excel, Power BI or similar reporting tools. * An interest in AI, automation and digital transformation. * Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Ideally, You'll Also Have * Experience supporting internal audit activities. * CQI membership or a desire to work towards Chartered Quality Professional status. * Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management standards. * Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma or other continuous improvement methodologies. * Experience using process mapping or workflow analysis tools. * Awareness of Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI or Microsoft Copilot solutions Why Jacobs? At Jacobs, you'll be part of a collaborative team helping to shape the future of infrastructure delivery. This role offers hands-on experience across quality, business improvement, governance, automation and digital transformation, providing an excellent platform for professional growth and long-term career development. Whether you're looking to deepen your quality expertise, build your analytical capabilities or develop skills in emerging technologies, we'll help you grow your career while contributing to projects that create lasting positive impact across Ireland. Benefits for Ireland Employees At Jacobs, we put people first and provide benefits that support your wellbeing, career development and work-life balance, including * Hybrid and flexible working arrangements * Professional membership reimbursement * Industry-leading learning and development programmes * Career progression opportunities across Ireland, the UK and globally * Employee assistance programme * Annual leave with the opportunity to purchase additional days * Pension scheme * Life assurance * Employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives * Inclusive culture that values diversity, belonging and individual growth Apply today and help us deliver smarter, more efficient and higher-quality outcomes across Ireland's most important infrastructure programmes Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees. With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs. We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here. Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles.
