title: Sample Management Technican
description: **Orion Group Life Sciences are currently recruiting a Sample Management Technician** **on behalf of our Multinational Biopharmaceutical Client based in Carlow on an initial 11-Month contract with potential to extend** The role is a day role starting 7:00 to 15:30 You will operate as part of the QC team performing the allocated testing and laboratory-based duties and although it is preferable that Analysts have Immunoassay and cell culture experience, we are open to considering applicants that fulfil the duties as detailed below. Our Quality Assurance group ensures every single material inside our products is manufactured, processed, tested, packaged, stored and distributed aligned with our incredibly high standards of quality and meets all regulatory requirements. Partnering across our internal manufacturing facilities, external contract manufacturers and suppliers we create an interdependent global manufacturing network committed to deliver a compliant, reliable supply to customers and patients on time, every time, across the globe. **What you will do:** * Receive, log, label, track and manage biological, environmental and manufacturing samples in accordance with site procedures and GMP requirements. * Maintain sample chain of custody and ensure sample integrity throughout receipt, storage, distribution and disposal activities. * Coordinate sample distribution to QC laboratories to support testing schedules and ensure timely product release. * Manage sample inventory within laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and other tracking systems, ensuring accurate and contemporaneous documentation. * Monitor sample storage locations, environmental conditions and retention inventories to ensure compliance with established procedures. * Work as directed by the Sample Management Lead / Manager in accordance with Company safety policies, cGMP and GDP requirements. * Drive compliance with Global policies, procedures, guidelines and regulatory requirements in the performance of all day-to-day activities. * Ensure all Quality Systems within the department are adhered to on a daily basis. * Support the timely receipt, processing and dispatch of samples to internal laboratories and external testing facilities where required. * Ensure timely completion of all sample management documentation, data entry and record reviews. * Participate in investigations relating to sample discrepancies, excursions, non-conformances and deviations. * Generate and review sample management metrics and trend data to support operational performance and continuous improvement initiatives. * Participate in QC Tier 1 daily meetings and ensure effective communication of sample volumes, priorities, issues and risks. * Perform peer review of sample management records to ensure data integrity and Right First Time principles are maintained. * Support laboratory audits and inspections by maintaining inspection-ready documentation and records. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives and participate in root cause investigations using tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams and FMEA. * Support management of laboratory consumables, sample containers and associated inventory where required. * May be required to perform other duties as assigned. **What skills you will need:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher preferred; ideally in a Science, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical or related discipline. * Experience working in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology or laboratory environment. * Knowledge of cGMP, GDP and laboratory quality systems. * Experience using LIMS, sample tracking systems or electronic inventory management systems. * Strong organisational and planning skills with the ability to manage high sample volumes and competing priorities. * Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data integrity principles. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office and job-related computer applications. * Experience writing reports, procedures and quality documentation is desirable. * Understanding of deviation management, investigations and change control processes. * Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma methodologies is advantageous. * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional team. * Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence. * High personal integrity, credibility, energy and flexibility. * Willingness to support the team and maintain a strong customer-focused approach. **People** are our business **worldwide** Orion Group was founded in 1987 and is now one of the largest, independent, international recruitment companies. We have a network of 200 employees working from 24 offices, delivering a range of services – Talent Acquisition, Recruitment Outsourcing Services, Retained Search, Global Workforce Solutions, Completions & Commissioning and Materials Management – across 68 countries. As a global leader in workforce solutions, we recruit personnel across the Engineering & Technical, Office & Commercial, Scientific and Skilled Trades disciplines, for sectors including Oil & Gas, Life Science, Power & Utilities, Constructions & Infrastructure, Manufacturing and Renewables.

title: Software Engineer, Security Business Enablement
description: Who we are **About Stripe** Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. **About The Team** Security Business Enablement (SBE) is Stripe's commercial security function: the interface between Stripe's internal security program and its Go-to-Market organization. We make sure security and compliance requirements never block, delay, or devalue Stripe's deals. This work is about customer trust: businesses entrust Stripe with critical financial infrastructure, and their security teams need confidence that Stripe meets rigorous standards before, during, and after the sale. We make that trust tangible with accurate, consistent evidence of Stripe's security posture. We own security due diligence end to end: questionnaire response, compliance evidence, live security reviews, gap and exception management, contractual security exhibits, rapid response during industry-wide events, and executive briefings. We engage customers directly, up to CISO level, and equip sales teams to handle security conversations on their own. Our scope is unusually broad: one assessment can span security, privacy, business continuity, and resilience, translating deep control detail into language procurement, legal, and a CISO can each act on. We are often the first team asked to represent emerging parts of Stripe's posture. We work at the intersection of security, AI, and Go-to-Market. Our platform is built on authoritative grounding: answers are retrieved from a knowledge base we maintain and validate, not generated from first principles, so they are consistent and source-traceable. Our POC proved the concept and outgrew what agent builders alone can do; taking it to production quality is the engineering problem this role exists to solve. What you’ll do **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and scale an AI-powered platform that delivers validated answers to security questions on demand, for both the sales teams who ask them and the customers who need them, replacing inconsistent ad-hoc responses with consistent, source-traceable ones * Build the retrieval, content pipeline orchestration, and integration layers that off-the-shelf tooling cannot deliver, including support for multiple cloud environments and Stripe's full and growing product portfolio, so that answers stay accurate as Stripe's infrastructure and products evolve * Build automations that keep security content current as Stripe rapidly adopts new technologies and introduces new controls, including automated refresh and review cycles that route content to subject-matter experts and Legal for validation * Build the capability to manage industry-standard certifications and assessment frameworks, including the Shared Assessments SIG and the Cloud Security Alliance CAIQ * Build analytics and evaluation capabilities that measure and continuously improve the performance and coverage of the security content library * Extend the same platform and knowledge base to power a public and authenticated Trust Center, giving customers direct self-service access to Stripe's security, privacy, resilience, and compliance posture * Partner with security analysts and with Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to expand coverage across Stripe's full security surface area, and own the reliability and operational health of what you build Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Requirements** * 2+ years of software engineering experience building production systems * Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job so our interview process is language agnostic) * Comfort working with retrieval-augmented architectures, content pipelines, and AI/LLM integrations, or demonstrated ability to learn quickly in these areas * Experience building workflow automation, including scheduled jobs, approval routing, and multi-stakeholder review processes * Comfortable instrumenting systems and working with data to measure quality, coverage, and performance, then using those measurements to drive improvement * Experience creating projects from scratch, taking ownership, and driving work to completion with minimal supervision * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with non-engineering stakeholders (security analysts, sales teams, legal) * Seek out opportunities for impact and can execute in a complex, cross-functional environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building AI-driven products or workflows, particularly retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems or knowledge management platforms * Experience building evaluation frameworks for AI systems, such as measuring retrieval quality, answer accuracy, or coverage gaps * Familiarity with cloud security concepts across AWS and/or Azure * Previous experience with security software engineering, compliance tooling, or GRC platforms * Familiarity with security assessment frameworks and standards such as the Shared Assessments SIG, Cloud Security Alliance CAIQ, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or ISO 27001 * Experience with content management systems, structured content modeling, or documentation-as-code approaches * Experience building customer-facing or internal self-service tools at scale * Comfort working in a small team where individual contributions have outsized, visible impact In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €85,000 - €127,600. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. description: Salary: DOE Location: Dublin, Ireland; Cork, Ireland; Contract Type: Full Time Permanent Inclusive Recruitment Guide for Candidates **- Download** **The Vacancy** **About the Company** At Nicholas O'Dwyer, sustainability is at the core of our work. If you are looking to advance your career in a socially responsible company, which has a proven track record over 90 years, and is committed to creating a sustainable planet, we invite you to be part of our team. Our mission is to provide innovative and reliable solutions using cutting edge technology and expertise, to ensure project success and employee satisfaction. We deliver infrastructure projects in water, wastewater, transportation, civil and structural engineering, flood protection, and energy including renewables. With headquarters in Ireland, we also operate in the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. As part of the RSK Group, an amalgamation of over 200 companies with more than 17,000 employees, we benefit from a global network of opportunities while retaining our brand and autonomy. **About the Role** This is an exciting time to be involved in transportation in Ireland, with a pipeline of nationally significant infrastructure projects expected to be delivered over the next decade. NOD is well positioned to play a key role in supporting these programmes, bringing strong technical capability, multidisciplinary delivery expertise and trusted client relationships across the transport sector. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Associate to join our Transportation team and help shape the successful delivery of this next generation of transport investment. The successful candidate will provide technical, project and commercial leadership across a diverse portfolio of roads, transportation, active travel, public realm, rail and ports projects in Ireland and internationally. Internationally, NOD has an established track record in the delivery of transportation schemes across Africa, including projects in Malawi, Rwanda, Mozambique, Tanzania and Kenya predominantly for Internationally Funded Institute (IFI) projects An aspect of the role will be supporting NOD in its role as Programme Delivery Partner on the MetroLink Project, one of Ireland’s most important public transport investments, contributing senior transportation, project delivery, coordination and stakeholder management expertise to this landmark programme. **Key Duties and Responsibilities** * Provide technical and strategic leadership in the planning, design and delivery of transportation and civil infrastructure projects through all stages of the project lifecycle. * Lead and oversee multiple projects, ensuring coordinated delivery to agreed scope, programme, budget, quality and commercial objectives. * Maintain broad technical literacy across transportation team, with sufficient depth to interrogate design assumptions, identify interfaces and risks, challenge technical decisions constructively, and provide authoritative direction on technical and contractual matters. * Guide engineers and project managers in selecting appropriate analysis, design and delivery approaches; review calculations, reports, drawings, specifications and technical submissions; and ensure that work is proportionate, coordinated, technically robust and compliant with applicable standards. * Provide senior technical oversight of geometric design for transport schemes, including horizontal and vertical alignment, junction and interchange layouts, cross-sections, visibility, access, active travel integration and coordination with drainage, structures, utilities, geotechnical and environmental constraints. * Provide senior technical oversight of pavement design and rehabilitation, including interpretation of ground investigation and traffic data, selection of pavement type and materials, pavement thickness design, assessment of existing pavement condition, constructability, whole-life performance, sustainability and coordination of specifications and maintenance requirements. * Plan resource requirements across existing and future pipelines of work, taking account of project programmes, capacity, utilization and financial needs, and working with the recruitment team to secure appointments where required. * Monitor project and portfolio performance, including risk, change, resourcing, cash flow, work in progress, invoicing, profitability, quality assurance and compliance with current technical standards and company procedures; identify and implement corrective actions where required. * Develop and maintain trusted client and partner relationships, identify emerging needs, convert opportunities into viable commissions and support the securing of repeat and new business. * Take responsibility for the financial management of projects, including fee and budget control, cash-flow forecasting, work-in-progress management, invoice coordination, payment tracking, sub-consultant costs and commercial reporting, in collaboration with team leaders and the Finance Department. * Business Development + Lead targeted business development activity in line with the approved Transportation strategy, including opportunity identification, pipeline planning and tracking, client engagement, commercial qualification and conversion planning. + Oversee pre-qualification and tender submissions, taking responsibility for bid strategy, technical content, fee preparation, commercial inputs, risk review, quality assurance and coordination with the Bid Department. + Work with other departments to support integrated tendering and service delivery, identify cross-company opportunities, and ensure that secured work is transitioned into commercially successful project delivery. * Demonstrate strong commercial awareness by understanding contractual obligations, managing scope and change, protecting fee recovery and margin, and escalating material commercial risks in a timely manner. * Provide visible technical leadership to engineers and project managers through coaching, structured reviews and day-to-day guidance; facilitate teams in solving complex problems, explain the basis for decisions, develop sound engineering judgement, and support succession and capability development. * Promote consistent application of NOD procedures, lessons learned, digital tools and relevant design standards, and create opportunities for staff to broaden their technical knowledge through mentoring, knowledge sharing, peer review and delegated responsibility. * Work with our HSQE department to ensure the transportation division, including site teams, adhere to Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Procedures * Contribute to the development and implementation of departmental and company strategy, technical standards, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. * Undertake additional duties as required to support project delivery and reflect the evolving needs of the business. **Key Requirements** * Degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline. * Chartered Engineer status, or an equivalent recognised professional qualification. * 12+ years of relevant post-graduate experience in transportation and civil infrastructure, with a strong record of increasing technical, project and commercial responsibility. * Recognised expertise in geometric and/or pavement design for transport schemes, supported by broad technical literacy across road drainage, geotechnical design, active travel and related interfaces. This should include the ability to review alignments, junction layouts, cross-sections, visibility requirements, pavement investigations, traffic loading, materials selection, pavement design and rehabilitation options, and to provide authoritative multidisciplinary direction. * Experience in the delivery of TII-funded projects and a strong understanding of the Transport Appraisal Framework (TAF) process would be a distinct advantage. * Experience in the delivery of IFI funded schemes would be advantageous. * Demonstrated experience in leading large or complex multidisciplinary projects, programmes or business sectors from project brief through to completion. * Strong experience in resource planning, programme management, financial management, risk management and commercial performance, including monitoring and improvement of project profitability. * Proven tender management and business development experience, including bid strategy, fee preparation and client relationship management. * Excellent verbal, written, presentation, negotiation and influencing skills, with the credibility to represent the company with clients and partners. * Demonstrated ability to teach, coach and guide engineering teams, facilitate the resolution of complex technical problems, undertake proportionate technical reviews, develop the judgement of others and maintain compliance with applicable technical standards. * Knowledge of Irish planning, public procurement and contract administration processes. * Familiarity with DMURS, the National Cycle Manual, TII Publications, the Traffic Signs Manual and other relevant Irish design standards. * Proficiency in relevant industry-standard design and project delivery software. Knowledge of Civil 3D, AutoCAD and traffic or transportation modelling software would be advantageous. * Leadership and Personal Attributes * You foster a working environment which supports co-operation, collaboration, diversity and inclusion, ownership and initiative. You understand group and social dynamics to build effective working relationships and can anticipate and address potential interpersonal issues before they become problems. You can create networks across cultures, organizations, internally and externally. * Proactive, accountable and capable of leading multiple priorities with minimal supervision. * Strong leadership and organisational skills, with the ability to build effective teams and networks across disciplines, offices and external organisations. * Confident in handling complex stakeholder matters, interpersonal challenges and difficult decisions objectively and constructively. * Committed to technical excellence, quality, professional development, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. This is an excellent opportunity for an established transportation professional to take a senior leadership role at a pivotal time for transport infrastructure in Ireland and to strategically guide the continued development of NOD’s Transportation department. This role offers the chance to shape departmental capability, market positioning and future growth, while contributing to nationally significant programmes, including NOD’s Programme Delivery Partner services for MetroLink, and supporting a diverse portfolio of domestic and international transportation commissions. **About Us** Our mission is to deliver sustainable solutions that transform communities and bring about lasting positive change. Through a blend of expertise, innovation and global dedication, we envision a world where sustainable engineering protects growing communities. Nicholas O’Dwyer provides professional services in engineering design, project management, environment and planning, construction supervision and technical and contract advisory. We are one of the most respected Irish consultancies operating in local and international markets, providing professional services to public- and private-sector clients. Whether in Ireland, the UK or internationally, we understand and solve major challenges associated with delivering and adapting infrastructure for an increasing global population while maintaining a sustainable environment for future generations. Nicholas O’Dwyer is part of the RSK Group, a leading integrated environmental, engineering, and technical services business providing dynamic, multidisciplinary services to a wide range of sectors. RSK was founded in 1989 and has grown considerably since then. At RSK, we operate as a group of businesses that work together seamlessly, aiming for growth through diversification. Our strategy helps us build a strong and resilient business, capable of weathering external challenges, while also providing greater value to our clients and more opportunities for our employees. Since the beginning, our philosophy has remained the same: employ, develop and reward talented individuals. People are crucial to our company, and we recognise that our success hinges on our colleagues' growth. We're committed to preserving RSK's people-first culture, promoting innovation, and fostering a supportive and caring environment for collaboration. At RSK, we want you to be part of our successes and help you reach your career aspirations. We take pride in offering employees fulfilling and challenging careers by promoting ongoing growth and empowering individuals to excel. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We firmly believe that embracing and celebrating the diversity in our workforce makes us a stronger and more innovative company. If you're passionate about making a difference, join us as we work together to build a brighter, more equitable, and sustainable future for all. Do you have what it takes? **Benefits** Generous Annual Leave Cycle to Work Scheme Mental Health Support Tax Saver Options Employee Assistance Program Staff Mentorship Program Retirement Saving Plan Flexible and Hybrid Working Arrangements 2 Professional Memberships Paid For Parking On-site
